sentences.en: Without dissemination of the facts, conspiracy theories will abound.
sentences.zh: 如果没有这些事实的传播，阴谋论将会泛滥。

sentences.en: The dissemination of scientific knowledge is essential.
sentences.zh: 普及科学知识是必不可少的。

sentences.en: The company used social media for the dissemination of their new product launch.
sentences.zh: 该公司通过社交媒体发布了新产品发布的信息。
